title: DECISION: articles table insert treated as hard error in pipeline
description: pipeline.rs returns Err immediately if the articles table INSERT fails, unlike log-append failures which are logged as warnings and continue. The comment explains: if the IPFS write, msgid_map insert, and group-log append all succeed but the articles table insert fails, the block exists in IPFS but is invisible to select_gc_candidates and will never be collected. This correctly identifies the articles table as the GC tracking ledger and treats its integrity as non-negotiable.
